description: May 2 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 2, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 2 birthday falls in Taurus, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a May 2 birthday
paragraphs: Two is the number of partnership, and on the 2nd of May it meets a Taurus Sun some eleven degrees along. Tradition gives this stretch a Mercury sub-ruler, so the steady Bull tends to talk things through before committing. Expect a loyal collaborator who prefers quiet negotiation to confrontation and who remembers, years later, exactly who showed up when it mattered.

By noon UTC on May 2, the Sun has normally reached roughly 11° of Taurus. That places the date in the Taurus decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the second of three. Mercury, the ruler of Virgo, acts as sub-ruler for Taurus between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of May. That pairing brings a practical intelligence to the sign's patience. These Taureans are frequently pictured as craftspeople at heart: they like to learn how something works, refine it and make it last. Speech tends to be measured and grounded in specifics. The Virgoan undertone can add a critical eye, which is helpful in a workshop or a spreadsheet and sometimes less welcome at the dinner table. Their gift is turning ideas into durable, useful things that other people can rely on for years.

sections.heading: Numerology of the May 2 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 2nd gives a birthday number of 2, unreduced and simple. Numerologists treat the day of birth as a secondary influence, a natural skill that colours the main Life Path without overriding it. The 2 is the number of the pair, so it is traditionally linked with tact, sensitivity and an instinct for what other people need. Someone born on this day may be the quiet mediator in a group, noticing tension long before it surfaces. The challenge often described for 2s is voicing their own view rather than adjusting it to keep the peace.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same May 2 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: May 2 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 2 is the 122nd day of the year (123rd in a leap year). In most years Gemini season is under way by May 21, 19 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 2 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. May 2 is also the birthday of Catherine II of Russia (1729), Satyajit Ray (1921) and David Beckham (1975).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 2?
faq.answer: May 2 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 2?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 2 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 2nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 2?
faq.answer: By May 2 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 2?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a May 2 birthday are Catherine II of Russia (1729), Satyajit Ray (1921) and David Beckham (1975). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
